title: IAEA Live Chart: 90Sr half-life 28.91 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 90Sr lists half-life 28.91 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 0.03 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 90Sr (Z=38, N=52), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 28.91, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 3, half_life_sec 912310729.9254547, and unc_hls 946707.77923776. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 0.03 years. The small integer unc_hl (3) matches that absolute uncertainty as 3 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 3 years on its own. The leading decay field is B- at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 1-Mar-2020. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.
